scope: For every gluing a1*Gamma1 + a2*Gamma2 and relative ideals A_i, the tensor product of the extension ideal with its dual factors over k[y] as T1 (x) T2; torsion-length law; minimal generators multiply; the extension has the Huneke-Wiegand property iff a factor is a non-principal ideal with it. Two explicit four-generated counterexamples. Ideals of a gluing that are not extensions are not covered.
